_comment: Phase-0 native viability config. Byte-for-byte the official simplified_react_code_agent DEV config (experiments/configs/simplified_react_code_agent/openai/gpt-4o-2024-05-13/dev.jsonnet) with ONLY the model endpoint swapped to the local Qwen3-32B-AWQ vLLM server. No prompt, agent, loop, or evaluator change. _transport_chat_template_kwargs is applied by run_phase0.py at the HTTP transport layer (OpenAI client extra_body), matching the official qwen3-*-without-reasoning model configs in experiments/configs/_generator/models/alibaba.py. It is NOT part of model_config passed to LanguageModel, because non_cached_lm_call in this checkout rejects extra_body even though the official config generator emits it.
